items.title: Trump announces deal for Russian diesel as Zelensky calls it a gift to Putin
items.description: Ukraine's president sharply criticised the move, calling it an "investment in war that must be ended, not prolonged".

items.title: Israeli drone attack wounds six in Lebanon near Syria border
items.description: Five Syrians and one Lebanese wounded in latest Israeli attack, Lebanon's health authorities say.

items.title: Trump says U.S. to get diesel from Russia, relaxing pressure on Moscow to ease prices before midterms
items.description: Trump says the U.S. will obtain diesel from Russia, relaxing years of U.S. pressure on Moscow, to combat prices before midterms. He said he struck the deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin in a phone call.

items.title: Trump strikes diesel deal with Putin, reversing years of pressure on Russia over Ukraine war
items.description: US President Donald Trump said Friday that Russia had agreed to immediately supply more than 300,000 tonnes of diesel to US and global markets in an effort to cut fuel prices before November's midterm elections. The move marks a stunning change of policy after the US and its allies hit Russia with waves of sanctions ov…

items.title: Trump says Putin agrees to major release of diesel to US, global markets
items.description: Trump's announcement on Friday also came as US, Ukrainian and European officials were due to hold talks in Miami in a fresh diplomatic effort to end Russia's war in Ukraine. Moscow, which launched its full-scale invasion in February 2022, occupies roughly one-fifth of Ukrainian territory.

items.title: Eritrean troops in Ethiopia raise fears of a regional war
items.description: Ethiopia and Eritrea are trading blame for confrontations in Tigray amid international calls for restraint. Their respective allies have the potential to catapult the conflict into a regional war.

items.title: World News in Brief: ‘Horrific’ attack in Sudan, Israeli incursions in Syria intensify, most women and girls homeless in Gaza
items.description: A suspected drone strike has left at least 40 dead in Sudan’s Blue Nile State – near the Ethiopian border - according to initial reports from the ground, according to UN Spokesperson Stéphane Dujarric. Most of the casualties were women and girls.

items.title: Dozens Killed In Russian Strike On Passenger Buses In Kramatorsk
items.description: Dozens of people were killed in a Russian strike on the Ukrainian city of Kramatorsk on October 8, according to local authorities, a day after another deadly barrage killed at least 25 people across Ukraine.

items.title: EU Lifts Belarus-Related Sanctions on Russian Billionaire Gutseriev – RFE/RL
items.description: The billionaire remains subject to separate EU sanctions linked to Russia’s war in Ukraine.

items.title: In Ukraine, holding on to childhood in a time of war
items.description: As war in Ukraine continues into its fifth year, some children have only known war. The Monitor revisits three young families striving to live full lives amid Russia’s military invasion.
